pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with soft edge gradients and smooth pixel transitions. Patch geometries are predominantly sub-rounded to angular, showing moderate spatial distribution across the visible flank and lower neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored pathways forming a topological mesh between patches. Junction nodes are visible at points of convergence for 3-4 patches, with relatively consistent pixel thickness throughout the visible area, though partially occluded by foreground vegetation.
